name: web-color-background-gradient-circles-blue-purple-eps-template
title: 'Color Background' template with overlapping blue-purple gradient circles and thin diagonal line strips
whatItIs: A vivid blue-to-purple gradient background with several large overlapping soft-edged circles, thin diagonal cyan line strips, a white outlined text box labelled 'Color background EPS 10' with small geometric shape icons (square, circle, triangle, X) at its corners.
whatItMeans: Versatile and vivid; large soft gradient circles give any content box on top instant visual richness.
techniques: Overlap several large soft-edged gradient circles for depth.
Add thin diagonal line strips as subtle texture.
Frame a content box with small corner shape icons.

vocabulary.definition: A circle with a blurred or feathered boundary.
A small geometric mark used to decorate a frame's corner.
